extension_description.message: Measure and export the text stored in the active ChatGPT conversation.

response_wait_hint.message: Measures the full conversation after the AI response completes.

baseline_success_hint.message: Server data loaded · Checkpoint updated · Completion and freshness of the latest AI response are unverified

full_success_hint.message: Active branch restored from the full conversation data

dom_success_hint.message: Supplementary measurement of messages loaded on this page only ($1)

baseline_loading_hint.message: Updates the checkpoint from data currently stored on the server without waiting for the response to complete.

baseline_failed_hint.message: Could not update the checkpoint. The previous reference value is retained.

baseline_export_cancelled_hint.message: Checkpoint loading was stopped for export. The previous reference value is retained.

verification_exhausted_hint.message: Could not verify the latest response within the automatic verification budget.

admission_rejected_hint.message: The latest user message could not be found in the current server data. The previous reference value is retained.

measurement_failed_hint.message: Could not read either the full conversation data or the on-screen messages ($1; $2).

conversation_loading_hint.message: Loads the server data once the conversation is created.

return_cancelled_hint.message: Checkpoint loading was stopped on returning to this page. The freshness of the previous reference value is unverified.

input_recovery_hint.message: Server data unverified · Sending your next message will load the server data again.

automatic_recovery_hint.message: Automatic verification unsuccessful · Your next message will trigger a checkpoint recovery attempt using server data.

next_verification_hint.message: The freshness of the current usage is unverified · Automatic verification will resume with your next message.

manual_recovery_hint.message: Click the usage to refresh manually now.

expand_hint.message: Open the conversation as a document.

expand_unconnected_hint.message: Document view is not connected yet.
expand_unconnected_hint.description: ChatGauge document view unavailable during UI preparation

export_initial_hint.message: Loads the full conversation again and saves it in the selected formats.

export_failed_hint.message: Not saved ($1). Click to load the data again.

export_hint.message: Loads and saves the current server data. Unverified completion notices are included inside files; the _unchecked filename marker is optional in settings.

export_formats_hint.message: Use the Export button in the conversation to save the selected formats. Multiple formats are bundled into one ZIP file.

options_open_hint.description: Home name button opens the existing options page

options_open_failed_hint.message: Could not open settings. Click again or use the ChatGauge icon in the Firefox toolbar.
options_open_failed_hint.description: Home options opening failed without changing the meter

filename_hint.message: Applies to your next export. Dates and times use UTC. Turn all three off to use only the conversation title. Unverified completion notices inside exported files remain.

refresh_mode_hint.message: When enabled, your messages trigger a server-data refresh without waiting for the AI response to complete. The latest response may not be reflected until your next message. When disabled, refreshes follow response completion.

refresh_scope_hint.message: Applies to all conversations. Changes take effect with your next message; loading already in progress continues.

settings_autosave.message: Your choices are saved automatically in this browser.

settings_load_failed.message: Could not load settings. Please reopen this window.

select_format_hint.message: Select at least one export format.

settings_save_failed.message: Could not save. Please select your preferences again.

filename_saved.message: Saved. Applies to your next export.

refresh_saved.message: Saved. Applies with your next message.

preservation_warning.message: This export contains the data currently stored on the server. The latest AI response may be missing or only partially saved. Response completion and freshness are not guaranteed.

send_key_hint.message: If you changed ChatGPT's send shortcut, select the field and press the same combination. Register one character key or Enter, with optional modifiers. This does not change ChatGPT's shortcut or the existing Enter detection. Applies to all conversations.
send_key_hint.description: Instructions and scope for additional send detection

send_key_invalid.message: Press a character key or Enter, with optional modifiers. Delete, cancel, and navigation keys are not supported.

send_key_saved.message: Additional send shortcut saved. Applies to your next key press.

view_again_hint.message: This view is temporary. Return to the conversation and select View to open it again.

expand_failed_hint.message: Could not open the conversation view ($1). Select View to try again.
